## Button

Button — triggers an action.

Use `primary` once per screen for the main action, `secondary` for alternatives, `tertiary` for
low-emphasis actions and `destructive` for delete/remove. Use `size="lg"` for main screen actions
and `size="md"` inside cards and rows. For navigation to another page, prefer a link (`asChild`).

Figma: Startline / Button — https://www.figma.com/design/TiHKqEUApUi1FNNtRGzAC7/Startline?node-id=94-2027

Source: `src/components/button/Button.tsx`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "tertiary" \| "destructive"` | `primary` | Visual emphasis (Figma `Variant`). - `primary` — the one main action on a screen - `secondary` — alternative actions - `tertiary` — low-emphasis text action - `destructive` — deletes or removes something |
| `size` | `"md" \| "lg"` | `md` | Height (Figma `Size`). `lg` = 52 px for main screen actions; `md` = 44 px inside cards and rows. |
| `leadingIcon` | `ReactNode` |  | Icon before the label (Figma `Leading icon`). Use an `Icon` or Lucide icon; sized to 20 px. |
| `trailingIcon` | `ReactNode` |  | Icon after the label (Figma `Trailing icon`), e.g. a chevron for "continue". |
| `asChild` | `boolean` |  | Render the child element (e.g. a router `<Link>`) with button styles instead of a `<button>`. |

Also accepts the standard HTML attributes of its root element (`className`, `id`, `aria-*`, events…).

```tsx
<Button variant="primary" size="lg" trailingIcon={<Icon name="chevron-right" />}>Continue</Button>
```

## Icon

Icon — the 12 Startline icons: 24 px outline, 1.8 px stroke at every size (like Figma), coloured by the surrounding text
colour (`currentColor`). Size follows `size-*` classes (default 24 px; Button sets 20 px).
Directional icons (chevron-right) mirror automatically in right-to-left layouts.

Interactive icons need a 44 px target — put them inside Button or BackButton, never alone.
For an icon that is not in this set, use `lucide-react` with `strokeWidth={1.8}`.

Figma: Startline / Icon — https://www.figma.com/design/TiHKqEUApUi1FNNtRGzAC7/Startline?node-id=93-1995

Source: `src/components/icon/Icon.tsx`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` * | `"path" \| "search" \| "chevron-right" \| "check" \| "close" \| "home" \| "resources" \| "chat" \| "profile" \| "bell" \| "calendar" \| "map-pin"` |  | Which Startline icon (Figma `Name`). |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name. Omit for decorative icons next to text (they are hidden from screen readers). Set it when the icon is the only content of a control or conveys meaning on its own. |

Also accepts the standard HTML attributes of its root element (`className`, `id`, `aria-*`, events…).

```tsx
<Icon name="bell" label="Notifications" />
```

## SearchField

Search field — single-line input for searching resources or lists, with a search icon and an
optional clear button. Use Text field for form data entry.
Figma `Query` is the placeholder (Default state) or the value (Filled state).
Always give it an accessible name: `aria-label` or a visible `<label htmlFor>`.

Figma: Startline / Search Field — https://www.figma.com/design/TiHKqEUApUi1FNNtRGzAC7/Startline?node-id=94-2158

Source: `src/components/search-field/SearchField.tsx`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | `"md" \| "lg"` | `md` | Figma `Size`: md 44 px, lg 52 px. |
| `onClear` | `(() => void)` |  | Called by the clear button. The button (Figma `Show clear`) appears when this is set and the field has a value. |
| `clearLabel` | `string` | `Clear search` | Accessible name of the clear button. |
| `fieldClassName` | `string` |  | Classes for the outer field (the input itself gets `className`). |

Also accepts the standard HTML attributes of its root element (`className`, `id`, `aria-*`, events…).

```tsx

```

## TextField

Text field — persistent label, editable value and optional helper. The error state explains how
to recover. 52 px control. Do not use Guidance card as a form field.
Figma `Value` is the placeholder (Default state) or the value (Filled state).

Figma: Startline / Text field — https://www.figma.com/design/TiHKqEUApUi1FNNtRGzAC7/Startline?node-id=95-1959

Source: `src/components/text-field/TextField.tsx`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` * | `string` |  | Persistent visible label above the field (Figma `Label`). Required — never rely on placeholder alone. |
| `helper` | `string` |  | Helper text under the field (Figma `Helper` + `Show helper`). |
| `error` | `string` |  | Error message (Figma `State=Error`). When set, the field turns red, the message replaces the helper and is announced to screen readers. Explain how to fix it, not just what is wrong. |
| `fieldClassName` | `string` |  | Classes for the outer wrapper (the input itself gets `className`). |

Also accepts the standard HTML attributes of its root element (`className`, `id`, `aria-*`, events…).

```tsx
<TextField label="Provider or contact" placeholder="Enter a name" helper="Check the details before saving" />
```

## Switch

Switch — turns a setting on or off immediately, without a Save button. Use for preferences;
use Choice card for questions. Give it a name with a `<label htmlFor>` or `aria-label`
(inside a Settings row the row label does this). 44×26 px; touch area extended to 46 px tall.

Figma `Checked` → `checked` / `defaultChecked`; `State=Disabled` → `disabled`.

Figma: Startline / Switch — https://www.figma.com/design/TiHKqEUApUi1FNNtRGzAC7/Startline?node-id=95-1984

Source: `src/components/switch/Switch.tsx`

_No Startline-specific props._

Also accepts the standard HTML attributes of its root element (`className`, `id`, `aria-*`, events…).

```tsx
<Switch aria-label="Appointment reminders" checked={on} onCheckedChange={setOn} />
```

## ChoiceCard

Choice card — a large tappable option with label and optional helper, for onboarding and
questionnaires. `single` behaves as a radio button, `multiple` as a checkbox (native inputs, so
keyboard and screen readers work). Wrap a group in `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>` question.
Use Switch for instant settings.

Figma: Startline / Choice card — https://www.figma.com/design/TiHKqEUApUi1FNNtRGzAC7/Startline?node-id=68-1043

Source: `src/components/choice-card/ChoiceCard.tsx`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` * | `string` |  | Main text (Figma `Label`). |
| `helper` | `string` |  | Supporting text under the label (Figma `Helper` + `Show helper`). |
| `selection` | `"multiple" \| "single"` | `single` | Figma `Selection`. `single` = pick one (radio — give all cards in a group the same `name`); `multiple` = pick several (checkbox). |
| `onCheckedChange` | `((checked: boolean) => void)` |  | Called with the new checked state (Figma `State=Selected`). |
| `onChange` | `ChangeEventHandler<HTMLInputElement, Element>` |  |  |

Also accepts the standard HTML attributes of its root element (`className`, `id`, `aria-*`, events…).

```tsx
<fieldset><legend>What do you need help with first?</legend>
  <ChoiceCard name="priority" value="housing" label="Housing" helper="Find a place to live" />
  <ChoiceCard name="priority" value="health" label="Health" />
</fieldset>
```

## Chip

Chip — a selectable filter. Selected = filter on; Disabled = unavailable (not the same as
unselected). Use in a row above lists. Use Badge for read-only status.

Figma: Startline / Chip — https://www.figma.com/design/TiHKqEUApUi1FNNtRGzAC7/Startline?node-id=94-2004

Source: `src/components/chip/Chip.tsx`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selected` | `boolean` |  | Figma `State=Selected` — the filter is on. Announced as "pressed". |
| `onSelectedChange` | `((selected: boolean) => void)` |  | Called with the new selected state when the chip is clicked. |
| `size` | `"md" \| "sm"` | `sm` | Figma `Size`: sm 36 px (44 px touch area), md 44 px. |
| `leadingIcon` | `ReactNode` |  | Figma `Show leading icon` — usually `<Icon name="check" />` on selected chips. |

Also accepts the standard HTML attributes of its root element (`className`, `id`, `aria-*`, events…).

```tsx
<Chip selected={f.housing} onSelectedChange={(on) => setF({ ...f, housing: on })}>Housing</Chip>
```

## SourceIndicator

Source indicator — shows where information comes from, to build trust. Place it next to facts
and AI answers. The label (Figma `Label`) is the children, e.g. "Official source", "Updated 3 May".

Figma: Startline / Trust / Source Indicator — https://www.figma.com/design/TiHKqEUApUi1FNNtRGzAC7/Startline?node-id=94-1961

Source: `src/components/source-indicator/SourceIndicator.tsx`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `"official" \| "verified" \| "updated" \| "ai-summary"` | `official` | Figma `Kind` — where the information comes from: `official` (government or the service itself), `verified` (checked by Startline), `updated` (last-updated date), `ai-summary` (written by AI — always show this on AI text). |
| `size` | `"md" \| "sm"` | `sm` | Figma `Size`: sm 24 px, md 32 px. |

Also accepts the standard HTML attributes of its root element (`className`, `id`, `aria-*`, events…).

```tsx
<SourceIndicator kind="ai-summary">AI summary</SourceIndicator>
```

## TaskCard

Task card — one next step on the user's path: status tag, title, optional description and meta,
and an action. Use for actionable steps; use Guidance card for information without an action.
Show at most one `next` card at a time.

Figma: Startline / Task Card — https://www.figma.com/design/TiHKqEUApUi1FNNtRGzAC7/Startline?node-id=94-2219

Source: `src/components/task-card/TaskCard.tsx`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `"next" \| "upcoming" \| "complete"` | `next` | Figma `State`: `next` = do now (highlighted), `upcoming` = later, `complete` = done. |
| `title` * | `string` |  | Figma `Title`. |
| `description` | `string` |  | Figma `Description` (+ `Show description`). |
| `meta` | `string` |  | Figma `Meta` (+ `Show meta`), e.g. "Recommended today". Shown with a calendar icon. |
| `actionLabel` | `string` |  | Figma `Action label`, e.g. "Start this step". |
| `actionHref` | `string` |  | Makes the action a link. |
| `onAction` | `(() => void)` |  | Makes the action a button. |
| `statusLabel` | `string` |  | Status tag text. Defaults to English "Next step" / "Upcoming" / "Complete" — pass translations. |
| `titleAs` | `"h2" \| "h3" \| "h4"` | `h3` | Heading level of the title, to fit the page outline. |

Also accepts the standard HTML attributes of its root element (`className`, `id`, `aria-*`, events…).

```tsx
<TaskCard state="next" title="Apply for a Social Insurance Number" description="You need a SIN to work in Canada."
  meta="Recommended today" actionLabel="Start this step" actionHref="/steps/sin" />
```

## SettingsRow

Settings row — a row in a settings list with label, current value and chevron; opens a detail
screen. Figma `State`: Pressed is the CSS :active state; Disabled → `disabled`.
Group rows in a list; for instant on/off use a Switch with its own label instead.

Figma: Startline / Settings row — https://www.figma.com/design/TiHKqEUApUi1FNNtRGzAC7/Startline?node-id=96-2023

Source: `src/components/settings-row/SettingsRow.tsx`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` * | `string` |  | Figma `Label`, e.g. "Language". |
| `value` | `string` |  | Figma `Value` — the current setting, e.g. "English". |
| `href` | `string` |  | Makes the row a link to the detail screen (otherwise a button with `onClick`). |

Also accepts the standard HTML attributes of its root element (`className`, `id`, `aria-*`, events…).

```tsx
<SettingsRow label="Language" value="English" href="/settings/language" />
```

```tsx
<BackButton onClick={() => router.back()} />
```

## BottomNavigation

Bottom navigation — fixed tab bar for the 5 primary destinations (Home, My Path, Ask, Resources,
Profile). Only on top-level screens; detail screens use Back button. Keep it fixed below the
scrolling content. Each item is a 44 px target; the current one is marked `aria-current="page"`.

Figma: Startline / Bottom Navigation — https://www.figma.com/design/TiHKqEUApUi1FNNtRGzAC7/Startline?node-id=94-2406

Source: `src/components/bottom-navigation/BottomNavigation.tsx`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active` * | `Destination` |  | Figma `Active` — the current destination. |
| `items` | `Partial<Record<Destination, { label?: string \| undefined; href?: string \| undefined; }>>` |  | Translated labels and/or real URLs per destination. Defaults: English labels, `/`, `/path`, `/ask`, `/resources`, `/profile`. |
| `linkAs` | `ElementType<any, keyof IntrinsicElements>` | `a` | Link element to render (e.g. your router's `Link`). Receives `href`. |
| `label` | `string` | `Main` | Accessible name of the navigation landmark. |

Also accepts the standard HTML attributes of its root element (`className`, `id`, `aria-*`, events…).

```tsx
<BottomNavigation active="home" linkAs={Link} items={{ ask: { label: "Demander" } }} />
```

```tsx
<AskStartlineAction onClick={() => openAssistant({ about: resource.id })} />
```

## AIAssistantPanel

AI Assistant Panel — one step of an AI conversation. Separates AI guidance from source evidence
and human support. Rules: always label AI text with `<SourceIndicator kind="ai-summary">`, always
show the sources it used, and offer human help (`escalation`) when the answer depends on legal,
immigration or eligibility decisions. Never present AI text as official.

Figma: Startline / AI Assistant Panel — https://www.figma.com/design/TiHKqEUApUi1FNNtRGzAC7/Startline?node-id=94-2315

Source: `src/components/ai-assistant-panel/AIAssistantPanel.tsx`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `"entry" \| "answer" \| "escalation"` | `entry` | Figma `State`: - `entry` — invite a question (highlighted): heading, intro, suggested questions, Ask action. - `answer` — AI answer: the question, an "AI summary" SourceIndicator, the answer, sources, actions. - `escalation` — hand-off to a human when a decision depends on the person's situation. |
| `title` | `string` | `Ask Startline` | Header title. |
| `subtitle` | `string` |  | Header subtitle, e.g. "AI navigation assistant", "Answer with sources", "When confirmation matters". |
| `footnote` | `string` |  | Small print at the bottom, e.g. "The linked source remains authoritative." |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | Panel content — compose it from Startline components (see stories). |

Also accepts the standard HTML attributes of its root element (`className`, `id`, `aria-*`, events…).

```tsx
<AIAssistantPanel state="answer" subtitle="Answer with sources" footnote="The linked source remains authoritative.">
  <AIAssistantQuestion>I just arrived in Ontario. What should I do first?</AIAssistantQuestion>
  <SourceIndicator kind="ai-summary">AI summary · sources shown</SourceIndicator>
  <p className="text-body text-text-primary">…</p>
</AIAssistantPanel>
```

---

## AIAssistantQuestion

The user's question, quoted inside an `answer` panel (Figma: "You asked" box).

Source: `src/components/ai-assistant-panel/AIAssistantPanel.tsx`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | `You asked` | Small label above the question. Translate it. |

Also accepts the standard HTML attributes of its root element (`className`, `id`, `aria-*`, events…).


---

## AIAssistantSuggestions

Suggested questions in an `entry` panel.

Source: `src/components/ai-assistant-panel/AIAssistantPanel.tsx`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `suggestions` * | `string[]` |  | Suggested questions, shown as chips (Figma: 3 small Chips stacked). |
| `onSelect` | `((suggestion: string) => void)` |  | Called with the chosen question. |

Also accepts the standard HTML attributes of its root element (`className`, `id`, `aria-*`, events…).
